sources.locator: The river Seine runs through Paris

sources.quote: Paris is the capital and largest city of France... Located on the Seine in the centre of the Île-de-France region.
The Seine is a 777-kilometre-long (483 mi) river in northern France... flowing through Paris and into the English Channel at Le Havre.
